payload.note: The normalized n=3 characteristic projector inherits the complete homogeneous charge--squeeze obstruction: fixed-vacuum grading leaks positive charge, while covariant grading has exact non-null free ghost-parity defect. A canonical two-sheet parity completion restores the finite formal charge/parity/projector package and preserves the sheet-normalized trace, but changes the source theory and leaves stationarity, asymptotics and physical affiliation open.
